description: A received DATA S_PDU whose TTD has passed is neither delivered nor answered, even though it asks for client delivery confirmation.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED goes at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made as the Called node (B-0213), with cas.first_data and the SIS soft link timers. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, EOT 20) carries a DATA C_PDU whose DATA S_PDU is priority 0, source SAP 5, destination SAP 9, CLIENT DELIVERY CONFIRM REQUIRED and VALID TTD set with day 1 and second 0 (byte 2 0xC1), and 'ping'. It is stored and acknowledged as in that scenario (C-0658, C-0776, C-0778), stops cas.first_data (B-0215), and as ARQ traffic restarts sis.soft_link_idle (interp A-0320). Core time 0 is 2026 day 1 at 00:00:00 (time.* defaults), so the TTD resolves to core time 0, inside the window from one day back to 15 days ahead, and it is not later than now (interp A-0167): it has passed. The U_PDU is not delivered and no DATA DELIVERY FAIL is sent (interp A-0241); the DTS still acknowledged the D_PDU, so at 83000 the same ACK-ONLY as in dts-arq/rx-data-acked goes. Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/rx-data-acked: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080).
